description: **Available 14th October  ** Discover this stunning, contemporary two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment, perfectly designed for modern urban living. Extending to a generous approx. 70 sqm, with an exclusively private garden patio, this residence offers a luxurious and highly efficient space. The apartment boasts a bright and spacious open-plan layout, featuring a large living/dining area. The high-end, fully fitted kitchen is a chef's delight. Accommodation includes two substantial double bedrooms, both with excellent built-in storage, with the master benefiting from a stylish en-suite. Secure parking is also available within the development.
